title: Battle Of The Barricades: U.S. Marines In The Recapture Of Seoul
summary: Battle Of The Barricades: U.S. Marines In The Recapture Of Seoul "Late on the afternoon of 24 September 1950, Captain Robert H. Barrow's Company A, 1st Battalion, 1st Marines, secured the military crest of Hill 79 in the southwest corner of Seoul, the enemy-occupied capital of the Republic of South Korea."
